report.summary: Guard remove() against an unknown id and add a regression test.

artifacts.title: Plan: Deleting an unknown todo removes the last one
artifacts.markdown:
## Problem
`TodoStore.remove` splices index -1 for an unknown id, deleting the last todo.

## Approach
- Return false before splicing when the id isn't found.

## Implementation steps
1. Guard `remove()` in `src/todos.ts`.
2. Add a regression test in `test/todos.test.ts`.

## Files likely touched
- `src/todos.ts`
- `test/todos.test.ts`

## Tests
- node:test: removing an unknown id keeps every todo.

## Risks and open questions
- None.

## Size
S

acceptanceCriteria: Removing an unknown id returns false and deletes nothing
